findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options header
findings.detail: No X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors CSP directive detected. Pages can be embedded in iframes, enabling clickjacking.

findings.title: Missing HSTS header
findings.detail: Strict-Transport-Security not set — browsers may fall back to HTTP on first visit.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
findings.detail: MIME-type sniffing not disabled — some browsers may interpret files as executable.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy header
findings.detail: No Referrer-Policy — full referrer URLs may leak to third-party requests.

findings.title: No Content Security Policy
findings.detail: No CSP header detected. XSS attacks lack a defence-in-depth layer.
findings.remediation: Define a CSP after auditing all inline scripts and external sources.

findings.title: No middleware.ts detected
findings.detail: Authentication is enforced per-route rather than at the middleware layer. A new route added without requireAuth() would be publicly accessible.
findings.remediation: Consider adding a Next.js middleware that validates the session for all /app/* routes as a defence-in-depth layer, in addition to per-route requireAuth().

findings.title: 10 API route(s) may lack authentication
findings.location: app/api/auth/change-password/route.ts, app/api/auth/reset-password/route.ts, app/api/fx/gbp-pkr/route.ts, app/api/fx/multi/route.ts, app/api/google/auth/route.ts, app/api/google/auth-notifications/route.ts, app/api/google/callback/route.ts, app/api/google/callback-notifications/route.ts, app/api/telegram/webhook/route.ts, app/api/whatsapp/webhook/route.ts
findings.detail:
These routes export HTTP handlers but do not appear to call requireAuth() or check CRON_SECRET:
app/api/auth/change-password/route.ts
app/api/auth/reset-password/route.ts
app/api/fx/gbp-pkr/route.ts
app/api/fx/multi/route.ts
app/api/google/auth/route.ts
app/api/google/auth-notifications/route.ts
app/api/google/callback/route.ts
app/api/google/callback-notifications/route.ts
app/api/telegram/webhook/route.ts
app/api/whatsapp/webhook/route.ts
findings.remediation: Add requireAuth(request) as the first call in every handler. If public, document why.

findings.title: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY used in GitHub Actions workflow
findings.detail: The service role key bypasses all RLS policies. If the GitHub Actions secret is compromised, an attacker has unrestricted database access.
findings.remediation: Create a narrowly scoped Postgres role with only INSERT/UPDATE on `pension_fund_prices` and use its credentials instead. See docs/security/SECURITY_CHECKLIST.md.
